senses.gloss:
आघुष् {c1c} P.
1 To proclaim, cry
aloud, declare.
--2 To praise.
--3 To
listen.
--4 To make oneself audible.
--{c10c} P. or Caus.
1 To make a noise,
to cause to sound.
--2 To proclaim,
announce publicly.
--3 To complain
continually, weep bitterly.

आघूर्ण् {c1c} A., {c6c} P.
1 To roll,
stagger, whirl, toss about;
आघूर्णतीवानिलैः (अंबरं) Mk. 5. 27;
पवनाघूर्णितपादप Hariv., Bk. 14. 77.
--2 To swim,
roll (as eyes); Ku. 3. 38.

आघूर्णनं Rolling, tossing about,
whirling round, swimming.
